procedure SkiLiftUpdate {
  about "Tell the lift company how many pickups are booked"
  policy SkiPolicy
  sheet Bookings "Bookings" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, pickup: Date, days: Number, prepaid: Money, status: Text, card_hint: Text private }
  trigger every day at 08:00

  let all = fetch Bookings
  let today = filter all where status == "booked"
  let n = summarize count of today
  if n == 0 {
    stop "no booked pickups"
  }
  let m = draft sms to "555-0177": "Hi the lift company, there are {n} booked pickups."
  let ok = request approval of m from owner timeout 1 day else stop "not approved"
  send ok
}
